## Kay Lord's Post

---

### **Kay Lord**

July 19

In 1960 when Nigeria gained independence, Nigeria's population was 45 million and the United Kingdom was 54 million.

Today, UK population is about 64 million, while Nigeria is over 200 million...

We've been very busy in the other room, while we are not busy in other productive area.

Selah!

All reactions:

34 comments

8 shares

Like

Comment

Most relevant



Kemi Adeloye

..The United Nations agency once came in here to help educate our people in the North about population control but it was weaponized as an attempt to destroy the fecundity of the North and a political gimmick to help the South to reduce their population, ostensibly engaging in the game of death by politicians and some of their elites. The laudable project was rejected.

Today, the unimaginable number of out-of-school children in the North constitute the feedstock of criminality in the entire country.

One of our Security men in time past brought in a little girl and excitedly introduced her to me as his wife while I was about driving out. I couldn’t stand the horror of the news I just got from him with the age of the girl not more than 10 years. I was halted in my outing plan momentarily. Adamu spoke to his “wife” in Hausa. And she greeted me to which I responded nicely.

In an attempt not to embarrass Adamu, I called him outside the gate to reconfirm what he told me as to whether “wife” or Sister. And he said: “Oga…Na my wife..!”. I was dumbfounded but handicapped. I brimmed with anger but could only express it in conversations with wifey. The young girl was subsequently put in the family way and died shortly after from complications of childbirth, being too young to go through such.

If we don’t get the North to step away from this culture of absurdity in child abuse of marrying 9/10-year olds and lining the streets with children that there are no plans and/or resources to care for, only to have them freeloaded unto the streets to become whatever, including taking to serious crimes; they would distribute the terrible aftermath all over the country. And we are seeing it already.

It is about time we in the South, boldly rejected this reckless attitude.
